meta.title: AI Readiness Assessment for SMEs
meta.description: Find out which of your processes suit AI before you spend on a build. A short assessment rates three processes; the comprehensive one adds a pilot plan.

hero.title: Find out where AI fits before you pay for a build
hero.lead: We look at your processes, your data and your constraints, and tell you which ones are a fit for AI, which are a conditional fit and which are not.

answer.label: In short
answer.text: The AI readiness assessment is Genixo's first step for AI projects. The short version is one call and a one-page summary that rates up to three processes as a fit, a conditional fit or not a fit. The comprehensive version adds a process map, a data inventory, a KVKK review, a rough return estimate and a pilot plan.

items.title: Is the work repetitive and frequent enough?
items.text: AI pays off on work that happens often, in a similar way. Rare, one-off tasks rarely justify the setup.

items.title: Is there data to learn and test from?
items.text: Past documents, quotes, calls or tickets with known correct outcomes are needed to build a test set.

items.title: What happens when it's wrong?
items.text: The cost of an error decides how much review the process needs, and whether AI belongs there at all.

items.title: Where may the data go?
items.text: Personal or confidential data changes the architecture: on your servers, in your cloud or through an API.

sections.label: Before the call
sections.title: What helps us give a useful answer
items: A short description of two or three processes that take your team the most time.
Rough volumes: how many documents, quotes, calls or requests per month.
The systems involved, such as your ERP, CRM or document storage.
Any rules about where your data may be processed.

sections.label: Limits
sections.title: What the assessment is not
items: It is not a sales pitch. “Not a fit” is a valid answer.
It does not replace the digital maturity report required by some KOSGEB programmes. [[TODO-071]]
It does not include a build. If a pilot makes sense, it is proposed separately.

sections.label: FAQ
sections.title: Questions about the AI readiness assessment

items.q: What is an AI readiness assessment?
items.a: It is a structured look at your processes, data and constraints that tells you which processes are suitable for AI, which could be with conditions, and which are not, with the reasons.
If a process is a fit, the usual next step is a fixed-scope pilot measured against a baseline. If none are, we say so, and sometimes suggest a software or data step first.

items.q: Does the assessment count for KOSGEB support?
items.a: No. Some KOSGEB programmes require a digital maturity report from an authorised organisation; our assessment does not replace it. [[TODO-071]]
